review_improvement: Preserves the OOB attachment/decode path and explicit GFX-to-GC mapping, avoiding both malformed endpoint use and substitution with the adjacent in-band dmesg case.
independent_technical_reasoning: The same block2 stimulus can be observed in-band or through CPER, but this testcase specifically validates OOB collection. Its decisive evidence is the GC bank plus ext59/GFX_IP_Fatal_Error on the intended OAM, linked to the command by time and attachment hashes. A driver log from row183 covers a different interface, and a CPER from concurrent activity would be a false positive. One injection minimizes fatal-state and attribution risk.
